09/ FAQ

Before you order.

How do I order?

Message us on WhatsApp at 0912 138 4977 or use the quote form below. Tell us what you want, how many, and send your design if you have one.

Do I pay before I know the price?

No. We confirm the design, quantity and price with you first. Nothing is paid until you agree to the price.

I don't have a design. Can you make one?

Yes. Tell us your name, colours, photo or message and we will design it for you.

Where are you located?

Katin Daji, Gusau. Call or WhatsApp 0912 138 4977 to arrange collection or delivery.

What is an NFC business card?

A smart card. Tap it on a modern phone and your name, number and WhatsApp open instantly, with no typing and no app.

Can you print for a wedding, campaign or business?

Yes. Cards, awards, shirts, caps, mugs, bottles, banners and campaign packs are all made to order.
